item.title: Uncertain Unreality: Re: Uncertain Unreality
item.content:encoded:
Firstly, what is the link between Scenario A and B besides the containment cell (which I’m assuming was constructed for the girl?). Right now, the way you’ve described both scenarios makes it seem as though both anomalies are entirely separate and they’ve only come together in a random and chance-encounter sort of way.

Right, I probably should've been more clear about it. Scenario A and B are considered, more or less the same anomaly, because as soon as someone learns of the SCP as a whole, they're randomly placed into one of the scenarios. For instance, you tell two people about SCP-XXXX, then show them the chamber. One person sees nothing, the other sees a person. At any given point in time this might randomly change, too. Now the one who saw a person now just sees nothing. They are the same anomaly all in all. And again, it's fundamentally impossible to prove which is the actual thing

Secondly, I’m having trouble believing the plausibility of the scenario. Yes, the young girl’s power might be significant, but how is she able to overwhelm the Foundation staff so easily? I’d imagine that agents would be well-equipped with amnestics and other precautions.

The real issue isn't the fact that this entity is powerful, it's the fact that n o t h i n g w o r k s. They try everything, be it mnestics, amnestics, everything. Reality anchors, hume readers, and every single time, the results seem to be fully subjective based on who views it. The whole point is that it's something that the foundation can't figure out. They can't get any semblance of accuracy, because they dont know what's accurate.
And they hate that. It's uncertainty
Again, it's either a person who makes half of the people who know of her unable to perceive her
Or a memetic hazard, which makes half the infected people perceive a person who doesn't really exist
But they have no idea which, since every point for one side has a counteracting point on the other.
It's… sorta meant to be confusing, because by the end, the readers won't know either. Because theres no way to know. It could be one or the other

I should note that part of this comes from my own personal experience. There was a time in my life where I didnt want to be considered a real person who existed. I wanted people to treat me like a myth, or a cryptid. It was a dissasociation thing, but whatever. Just something to keep in mind

item.title: Tectonic Watchers: Re: Tectonic Watchers
item.content:encoded: That sounds really interesting and dynamic. So maybe you'll want to expand on why they cause these earthquakes in some way whether that be a flat out answer, a mostly mysterious hint, or what have you. Given that the foundation commonly works to avoid disasters, they likely wouldn't attempt an all-out war without the certain leverage or answers of some other SCPs at the foundation's disposal. I could absolutely see them preparing repair/response teams to either stop/lessen the quakes and/or repair the damages & people and predictions could actually fit really well with that. The most interesting and probably difficult way would be for the Foundation to establish some form of agreement of peace. Remember: Secure, Contain, Protect. Think about what's going into the procedures portion.

item.title: Ovda Regio - Aphrodite: Ovda Regio - Aphrodite
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article/GoI

Genre (Optional): Galactic, Mystery

Page Layout (Optional): ACS header, basic layout, and exploration logs.

Elevator Pitch: Venus, a dead toxic planet believed to have no life on it, just sent signals to the SCP foundation, and no one knows who or why they did it, but they'll find out one way or another.

Central Narrative: (SCP) The SCP is currently classified as a signal, mainly because the origin is not yet located, and no one knows where it's precise location is, besides the fact it's located in the Ovda Regio, a massive landform (5280 km) located in the Aphrodite landmass. No one knows if it's a lost tribe, a massive monster, or a distress signal. Signals usually come in an unknown translation of code, and impossible to decipher.

(GoI) The team designated to the Ovda Regio is the ORET (Ovda Regio Exploration Team). They are responsible for scanning the OR in search of the origin of the signal, hoping they don't die from the harsh elements. Because of the toxic environment, limited time on the ground, and the amount of knowledge about the lands, the origin will take a very long time to locate, and has a possibility of not being found at all.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The most interesting part will 100% be the exploration logs, as there are an abundance of them, and they all are full of interesting content.

Additional Notes: If you want to know what the Ovda Regio is, here's a link. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ovda_Regio

item.title: Tectonic Watchers: Re: Tectonic Watchers
item.content:encoded:
Thank you for responding!

I intend for the MTF unit to originally only stay there to gain more Intel, however slowly come to learn that it's actually an entire race of people which are seemingly god-like. The reason they took him is because he's the first non-light entity to attempt to interact with them in all of history. Of course they know about humans, but not much as they only seem to watch earthquakes or other catastrophic events such as Volcanoes and the like.
He'd slowly figure out most of the information due to inference and suggestion from the entities.
While I haven't directly decided on this 100%, I've been considering the fact that these SCPs are actually revealed to manually move tectonic plates to cause earthquakes, which would be extremely dangerous if they're capable of doing that.
I was considering that due to the nature of the SCPs extreme difficulty to contain and high danger, the SCP Foundation could possibly attempt to even attack the entities whilst they're appearing during an earthquake to neutralize the threat of extreme magnitude seismic activity - (due to specific patterns of locations in which they appear they could possibly predict the location of the next light). That may give the MTF a choice between choosing The Foundation or SCPs. I'd have to decide which they choose from there.
This war could then tie in with the MTF which you mentioned attempting to neutralize the entities seemingly inside of an entire war between these light beings & The Foundation. I'd have to choose how that ends, however. If they're capable of just shifting tectonic plates it could end in a possible XK-Class Scenario, ending the entire world, however I don't know if my first SCP would be allowed to go that far. I'll have to think about the escalation of it a bit more.

Reply to below, as I don't want to further the thread:

You saying that gave me another possible idea that the MTF is actually a "spokesperson" for the light people, and he advocates for the peace between them and delivers messages. I'll continue to think about it as much as I can, as it'd make sense the SCP Foundation wouldn't want to engage war.

item.title: Tectonic Watchers: Re: Tectonic Watchers
item.content:encoded:
In the tale itself, you should probably develop in the writing who the protagonist holds allegiance to as the events unfold. Does he hold sympathy towards them, is he still set on getting them into containment, or is he just waiting it out to get away? Why are the lights telling him all this information?
When it comes to the SCP: What is the danger or interesting aspects of these lights themselves? Is this location the lights take him to also a factor in the SCP? The SCP log would benefit if it contains the Foundation's management of the damages if at all. If the foundation is entirely unable to contain, influence, or mitigate the SCP's exposure to the outside world, it just feels sort of useless to read as part of the SCP foundation unless it's tied into other portions of the foundation. I could see potential tie-ins with SCP-1000, MTF Ghost busters, MTF Mole Rats, MTF City Slickers, and MTF White Rabbits if you're comfortable with them. Make sure to include how they are managed by the foundation to the best or their ability.
